subject: Publisher portal service identity, delegated SKUs, and offer orchestration
messages:
From: Lydia Cho <lydia.cho@edgeware.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Getting started with publisher portal + service identity

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the call earlier — we’re excited to get Edgeware listed in the Azure Marketplace. A couple of immediate questions as we start the onboarding work:

- Do we need a dedicated service principal for the publisher portal or can we reuse the existing infra identity used for our deployment?
- For delegated SKUs (we plan to offer metered and subscription SKUs), any recommended pattern to map our SKU ids to the marketplace SKUs so billing events line up?
- Can you confirm which artifacts you’ll need from us for the technical validation gate? I attached the initial metadata CSV to this email.

Appreciate any quick guidance — procurement also wants a rough timeline so they can schedule signatures.

Thanks,
Lydia
Head of Partnerships
Edgeware Solutions
Attachments: edgeware-marketplace-metadata.csv

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Cho <lydia.cho@edgeware.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Getting started with publisher portal + service identity

Lydia —

Great questions, thanks for the CSV. Short answers up front, then a suggested next step.

1) Service identity: create a dedicated service principal for the publisher portal integration. Using a dedicated SP avoids permission sprawl and makes audit/logging easier for the validation checks. We’ll need the client ID + an ephemeral cert or client secret (we prefer cert for production).

2) Delegated SKUs: map your internal SKU IDs to the marketplace SKU IDs in a one-to-one CSV. Include billing unit (monthly/consumption), meter dimension name for metered SKUs, and a human-friendly display name. We can provide a template — see note below.

3) Technical validation artifacts: we require: a) publisher account proof (org admin statement + domain verification), b) service principal with minimum role list, c) sample telemetry showing usage events (to verify meter mapping), and d) image/asset proofs for the offer page. Your metadata CSV is a good start.

Suggested next step: can you and procurement sign off on a 30-minute handoff next Thursday (6/17) so we can walk the template and confirm the SP permissions? Marissa — want to own the meeting invite / agenda? Karthik, FYI on delegated SKU mapping patterns we discussed in partner sync.

Thanks,
Connor
Platform Partnerships (Redwood Inference)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Cho <lydia.cho@edgeware.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Getting started with publisher portal + service identity

Lydia — putting a draft invite on the calendar for Thu 6/17 10a PT. Agenda in brief:

- 10:00a: Intros and high-level timelines (5m)
- 10:05a: Publisher account proof & identity pattern (Connor) (10m)
- 10:15a: SKU mapping template review (Karthik) (15m)
- 10:30a: Technical validation checklist and attachments (Soojin) (10m)
- 10:40a: Next steps / ownerships (5m)

Can you confirm Lydia that procurement can join (or send purchase contact) so we can capture signature timing? I’ll attach the SKU mapping template and the SP permission matrix ahead of the meeting.

—Marissa
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

From: Lydia Cho <lydia.cho@edgeware.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@edgeware.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Getting started with publisher portal + service identity

Thanks Marissa — we see the invite. Procurement will be there (Andrea from procurement looped). A couple of quick clarifications before the call:

- For the service principal cert, our security team prefers cert over long-lived client secrets. Is there an expiry expectation from Microsoft for the marketplace SP cert?
- We have a multi-tenant deployment — do you recommend creating one SP per tenant or a single multi-tenant SP?

Attached the proof of org admin & domain verification we have; it’s the standard verification PDF but I can provide additional attestation if needed.

Best,
Lydia
Edgeware Solutions
Attachments: publisher-auth-proof.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Cho <lydia.cho@edgeware.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Getting started with publisher portal + service identity

Lydia — quick notes from the handoff: great meeting. Key decisions / action items summarized below (I'll also drop these in the shared doc):

- SP pattern: single dedicated service principal scoped to publisher operations. For multi-tenant deployments, prefer a central SP + tenant-specific tokens if you need per-tenant access isolation. Our recommendation is the central SP for offer management and a short-lived per-tenant token flow for tenant-specific provisioning.
- Cert expiry: Microsoft accepts certs with up to 2-year validity for publisher SPs, but rotate at 6-month cadence is recommended. Document this for your security team.
- SKU mapping: Karthik will send the mapping template and an example where a single internal SKU maps to both subscription and usage meters (see the spreadsheet).
- Artifacts needed for validation: publisher-auth-proof.pdf (you provided), completed SKU CSV, sample telemetry (at least 7 days), offer images (1024x1024 hero + screenshots).

Action owners:
- Lydia / Edgeware procurement: finalize SP cert + deliver telemetry export (due 6/25)
- Karthik: send SKU mapping template + sample mapping by EOD 6/17
- Soojin: populate technical validation checklist in Drive and request Marketplace Support escalation if any gating issues (owner: soojin_lee)
- Connor: coordinate final validation window and confirm co-sell readiness.

Connor

From: Azure Marketplace Support <am-support@microsoft.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Cho <lydia.cho@edgeware.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Publisher portal service identity, delegated SKUs, and offer orchestration

Hello Soojin / Connor —

Thanks for the heads up. We reviewed the submitted publisher-auth-proof.pdf and the initial CSV; two quick items before we can move to the technical gate review:

1) The SKU CSV needs a column for \"meterDimensionId\" for any metered SKUs — please add that and re-upload.
2) For the service principal, Microsoft requires the SP to have at minimum the \"Contributor\" role on the offer resource group and \"Website Contributor\" for the publisher portal calls. If you plan to scope narrower, include the exact API calls and we will evaluate.

If Edgeware can provide the telemetry export and updated CSV by EOD 6/25 we can schedule the validation window for the week of 6/28. Otherwise earliest slot will shift.

Regards,
Azure Marketplace Support
Attachments: (none)
